description: The menu bar popover: live state, pause, access requests, the tray icon and its menu, notifications, the servers (to name the one open now and open it) and their workspaces (to offer this computer to one once), open at login once the site pairs this computer and, on a Mac, whether its permissions are on (Prepare this Mac opens while one isn't), the app layer's screens in the main window (This computer's settings, the offer, Prepare, the first run: ADR 0256), this computer's essentials (open at login, the macOS permissions with the notifications' own prompt, what keeps the server here up: `health_get`) for the tray, a notification when one falls and the site (`health_publish`), the microphone's privacy pane and the Local Network prompt when the site asks for them, the server here (its state, start, stop, restart, its organizations' connections), the night's update install, and the system's own dialog before quitting while agents work here.
